project.title: Isolation, Genomic Characterization, and Biocontrol Potential of a Bacteriophage Cocktail against Staphylococcus aureus in Milk
project.description: The objectives of this study were to isolate, characterize, and evaluate the biocontrol potential of Staphylococcus aureus-targeting bacteriophages in milk.
project.center_name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, Ankara University (FVMAU)
